text: 三安光电：8月31日，公司董事长林志强先生增持公司股份77万股，约占公司总股本的0.02%，增持金额人民币997.7万元。截至本公告日，林志强先生累计增持公司股份357万股，约占公司总股本的0.07%，累计增持金额人民币4985.78万元。本次增持计划实施完毕。
text_en: Sanan Optoelectronics: On Aug 31, the company's chairman Mr. Lin Zhiqiang increased his shareholding in the company by 770,000 shares, accounting for about 0.02% of the company's total share capital, with an increase amount of 9.977 million yuan. As of the date of this announcement, Mr. Lin Zhiqiang has cumulatively increased his shareholding by 3.57 million shares, accounting for about 0.07% of the company's total share capital, with a cumulative increase amount of 49.8578 million yuan. This buyback plan has been completed.
